## Endpoints

### Data Read (8)
- `GET /{id}` — Get details for a specific user or post by ID.
- `GET /messages/application_shell.json` — Retrieve application shell configuration.
- `GET /navigation/waas_unread_inbox` — Check for unread inbox messages.
- `GET /posts/{postId}/{postId}` — Get details for a specific post by ID.
- `GET /user_follows/for_entity/post/{postId}` — Get user follow information for a specific post.
- `GET /user_follows/recommendations` — Get user follow recommendations.
- `GET /user/{userId}/new_messages` — Check for new messages for a specific user.
- `GET /user/current_user.json` — Get information about the currently logged-in user.

### Data Write (2)
- `POST /dashboard/items` — Create a new dashboard item.
- `PUT /feed-v2/posts/{postId}/open` — Mark a post as opened.

### Realtime (1)
- `GET /bookface_api/home/events.json` — Get real-time home event updates.

### Config (1)
- `GET /unleash/proxy` — Retrieve feature flag configuration.

- Internal APIs can change without notice — endpoints may break
- Rate limits are unknown — be conservative with request frequency
